record.question: As per Champion and Seth (1968) the number of forest type groups in Mizoram is:
record.explanation: Four forest type groups occur in Mizoram: tropical semi-evergreen, tropical moist deciduous, subtropical broadleaved hill and subtropical pine forests; these contain six forest types, which must not be confused with the number of groups. The printed question and choices on page 3 agree with the packet; Forest Survey of India confirms the distinction in its 2011 report (https://fsi.nic.in/cover_2011/mizoram.pdf).
